subject: Billing transfer request: NorthStar Payments -> BrightWave Technologies
messages:
From: Tom Richardson <tom.richardson@northstar-payments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Santos <emily.santos@northstar-payments.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Upcoming transition: billing entity change for Redwood subscription

Hi Marissa,

Quick heads-up: NorthStar Payments was acquired by BrightWave Technologies effective Feb 1. Legal has asked that, for invoicing and tax purposes, all future invoices be issued to the acquiring entity, BrightWave Technologies, Inc. We want to make this as clean as possible for both teams.

What we need from Redwood:
- Update billing entity/name on account to "BrightWave Technologies, Inc." and re-issue outstanding invoices dated Feb 1 onward to BrightWave.
- Reissue the invoice covering the Feb 1 billing period pro-rated to the new entity or provide a credit + new invoice — whichever is Redwood's standard practice.
- Receipts/Invoices must include BrightWave's EIN and VAT info (details below).
- Confirm whether a signed amendment or PO is required to complete the change.

Attached is the signed acquisition notice for your records (signed-acquisition-notice.pdf). We'll also attach the PO once finance routes it.

BrightWave billing details (as provided by their legal):
BrightWave Technologies, Inc.
EIN: 12-3456789
VAT (EU operations): GB123456789
Billing address: 1020 Harbor Rd, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94111

Please let me know next steps and any documents you need from our side. We aim to have billing transitioned within two weeks.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Richardson
CFO, NorthStar Payments
tom.richardson@northstar-payments.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: signed-acquisition-notice.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Richardson <tom.richardson@northstar-payments.com>
Cc: Emily Santos <emily.santos@northstar-payments.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming transition: billing entity change for Redwood subscription

Tom — thanks for the notice and the attachment. Congratulations on the acquisition. We'll prioritize this.

Next steps from Redwood (high level):
1) Finance needs the PO or signed amendment to change the contract counterparty (please attach PO when available).
2) We can either reissue the Feb 1 invoice to BrightWave or issue a credit to NorthStar and generate a new invoice to BrightWave — Vivek, please advise preferred approach and estimated timeline.
3) We'll need a completed W-9 (for US entity) or VAT registration documentation for BrightWave — Emily, can you send the W-9?

Vivek and Laura are looped in to coordinate accounting and contract ops. If you prefer, we can start with a temporary billing address change while paperwork completes; final legal entity changes will require the amendment.

I'll draft the amendment template for signature and share a DocuSign link once finance confirms process.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Upcoming transition: billing entity change for Redwood subscription

Marissa / team —

Thanks, Marissa. Internal checklist for billing entity transitions (summary):
- Required: signed contract amendment OR new PO referencing the existing subscription ID.
- Required: tax doc (W-9 for US entity) or VAT registration for EU entities.
- For historical invoices: standard practice is to issue a credit for the original invoice and generate a new invoice under the requested legal entity. We can also reissue the invoice in place if the customer prefers — both routes require an audit trail.
- Processing time: once we have signed amendment + tax doc + PO (if provided), we expect 7-10 business days to update our billing system and reissue documents.

Attachments: billing-change-checklist.pdf (internal) — includes template language we can add to the amendment.

Please confirm if BrightWave wants a single credit + new invoice or in-place reissue. Also send bank/wire instructions if they want payments routed to a different account.

Vivek
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@northstar-payments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Feb 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming transition: billing entity change for Redwood subscription

Hi Marissa / Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the quick response. Attached are the additional documents you requested: PO-4567.pdf (our finance PO referencing the subscription ID) and the signed acquisition notice (again). Also attached is BrightWave's W-9 and VAT registration summary.

BrightWave preference:
- Please issue a credit for any invoices dated Feb 1 onward to NorthStar and create a new invoice issued to BrightWave Technologies, Inc.
- Reissued invoices should list BrightWave's EIN (12-3456789) and VAT number (GB123456789) where applicable.
- For payment routing: BrightWave will continue to use the same payment flow for now; they will advise if banking details change. If you need bank info now we can provide it.

Let us know when you have the DocuSign amendment and the expected date for the reissued invoice. We are timeboxed — need documentation for our quarter close.

Best,
Emily Santos
Finance Manager, NorthStar Payments (now part of BrightWave)
emily.santos@northstar-payments.com

Attachments: PO-4567.pdf, W-9-BrightWave.pdf, VAT-registration-BW-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@northstar-payments.com>, Tom Richardson <tom.richardson@northstar-payments.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 18:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming transition: billing entity change: next steps and DocuSign

Emily / Tom —

Thanks for the PO and the tax docs. Vivek confirmed the credit + new invoice path is the cleanest for audit purposes. I've initiated the amendment and sent a DocuSign request to the BrightWave signing contact (link below). Once the amendment is countersigned, finance will:

- Create credit(s) for invoices dated Feb 1 onward under NorthStar account.
- Issue new invoices to BrightWave Technologies, Inc. (EIN on file).
- Reissue the Feb 1 invoice as requested — expected delivery: within 7 business days after amendment is returned.

DocuSign amendment (action required): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/amendment-NW-2026-0042

Provisional note: if BrightWave needs an immediate invoice for quarter close, we can issue a provisional invoice labeled "Pending amendment — billed to BrightWave" and follow up with proper credit/new invoice once the amendment clears. Please tell us which you prefer.

I'll follow up with the reissued invoice PDF and a confirmation email to the payment contact once processed.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood-invoice-2026-02-01-reissued.pdf (will be generated after amendment)
